title: Scout Search
summary: Bounded search planning, live search API adapter, source deduplication and cited synthesis.
status: Live web search requires a search-provider key; fixture mode is labeled cached evidence.

title: Pulse Voice
summary: Ordered voice sessions with VAD, interruptions, STT/reasoning/TTS adapters and stale-turn suppression.
status: Browser audio tools are usable locally; provider conversation needs an authenticated backend and API key.

title: Prism Multimodal
summary: Inspectable evidence manifests for text, images, audio and code, with optional grounded model interpretation.
status: Local file and code inspection works; image/audio reasoning requires a configured provider.

title: Review Swarm
summary: Separate reviewer, security and test roles propose bounded revisions and retain an audit trail.
status: Static analysis works locally; model proposals need configuration. Submitted code is never executed or automatically merged.

title: DomainLab
summary: A genuinely trained SQL intent adaptation baseline with frozen vocabulary and held-out evaluation.
status: Classifier is trained: 107/128 held-out cases correct. Optional Hugging Face causal-LM training entrypoint is unrun.

title: Guardrail Lab
summary: Deterministic injection/PII probes and a configured-model evaluation adapter with per-case scoring.
status: Local heuristic testing is available; scores do not certify model safety and live model probes need a key.

title: QueryLens
summary: CSV schema inference, natural-language aggregate planning, restricted SELECT execution and chart data.
status: Working local grammar plus SQLite backend; open-ended language-to-SQL needs a model. No arbitrary database connection is advertised.

title: ContextBridge MCP
summary: Real stdio MCP server and client exposing allowlisted portfolio context and read-only sample analytics.
status: Real protocol round-trip tested locally; the public browser preview explains tools and connects to your backend.

title: Portfolio Copilot
summary: A resume-and-portfolio-only retrieval assistant with source references and opt-in backend feedback.
status: Working extractive answers; generated responses need configuration. No external-user count claimed.
